description: Work out a paid time off (vacation or sick leave) balance pay period by pay period under the policy you send: accrual per hour worked (for example 1 hour per 30 worked) or a fixed amount per pay period, an optional balance cap, an optional yearly accrual cap, an optional carryover limit at the start of each plan year, and the order of accrual and use within a period. Send the starting balance and each pay period's end date, hours worked and hours used. Get back, per period, the hours accrued, the hours lost to a cap, the hours used and the balance, the hours removed at each plan-year carryover, and the ending balance. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/pto-accrual). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

accrued_this_plan_year.description: Hours already accrued in the plan year of the first period, before it (default 0). Counts toward annual_accrual_cap when you start mid-year.

annual_accrual_cap.description: Optional: most hours accrued in one plan year.

balance_cap.description: Optional: the balance never accrues above this many hours (accrual stops at the cap and resumes once hours are used).

carryover_cap.description: Optional: at the start of each new plan year the balance is cut to this many hours (what is cut is forfeited or paid out under your policy).

decimals.description: Each period's accrual is rounded to this many decimals of an hour, half up (default 4).

earn_hours.description: per_hour_worked: hours of PTO earned (the 1 in '1 hour per 30 worked').

hours_per_period.description: per_pay_period: hours of PTO accrued each pay period (for example 3.0769 for 80 hours a year over 26 periods).

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'vacation policy B 2026' (your own text, echoed; not a person's name).

method.description: per_hour_worked: accrue earn_hours for every per_hours_worked hours worked. per_pay_period: accrue hours_per_period each period.

order.description: Within a period: add the accrual before taking out hours used (default), or after.

per_hours_worked.description: per_hour_worked: hours worked that earn earn_hours (the 30 in '1 hour per 30 worked').

periods.description: Pay periods in date order (1 to 200).

end_date.description: Last day of the pay period, YYYY-MM-DD; the period belongs to the plan year that holds this date.

hours_used.description: PTO hours taken in the period (default 0).

hours_worked.description: Hours worked in the period (needed for per_hour_worked; not used for per_pay_period).

plan_year_start.description: First day of the plan year as MM-DD (default 01-01; a hire-date anniversary works too).

starting_balance.description: Balance in hours before the first period (default 0; negative only if your policy lets people borrow ahead).
